tests.title: apiPackages is exactly the ten expected entries in the expected order
given: internal/policy/layout_test.go declares apiPackages
tests.when: the test compares apiPackages with the literal list element by element
then: len(apiPackages) is 10
entries are ".", "core", "tools", "codemode", "workspace", "guard", "provider/faux", "sandbox", "codesearch", "mcpserve" in that order
a mismatch names the index and both values
tests.pseudocode: want = [".","core","tools","codemode","workspace","guard","provider/faux","sandbox","codesearch","mcpserve"]; assert len(apiPackages)==len(want); for i: assert apiPackages[i]==want[i]

tests.title: exportedAPI returns the PRD 12 identifiers for guard, provider/faux, sandbox and mcpserve
given: repoRoot(t) resolves the repository root
spec 22 and spec 23 have landed
tests.when: exportedAPI is called on the guard, provider/faux, sandbox and mcpserve directories
then: each returned list is non-empty
guard has a line beginning `func Allow(`
provider/faux has lines beginning `func ToolCall(` and `func Text(`
sandbox has a line beginning `func Open(`
mcpserve has a line beginning `func New(` and a line beginning `type Endpoint`
tests.pseudocode: for pkg, prefixes in {guard:["func Allow("], provider/faux:["func ToolCall(","func Text("], sandbox:["func Open("], mcpserve:["func New(","type Endpoint"]}: lines = exportedAPI(t, root/pkg); assert len(lines)>0; for p in prefixes: requireLine(t, pkg, lines, p)

tests.title: codesearch's exported API shows New over *workspace.Workspace and lists the Windows stub beside the real declarations
given: codesearch/index.go and codesearch/stub_windows.go both exist
spec 20 has changed New to take *workspace.Workspace
tests.when: exportedAPI is called on the codesearch directory
then: the list is non-empty
a line beginning `func New(` contains `*workspace.Workspace`
method lines with the real receiver name (idx) and lines with the stub's unnamed receiver `(*Index)` both appear, as separate lines
no line mentions `Ignore` as a field of Options
tests.pseudocode: lines = exportedAPI(t, root/codesearch); assert any(l startswith 'func New(' and '*workspace.Workspace' in l); assert any('func (idx ' in l); assert any('func (*Index)' in l)

tests.title: The golden's section headers equal apiPackages in order and nothing else
given: internal/policy/testdata/exported-api.golden is committed
tests.when: the test collects every line beginning `== ` from the golden file
then: the header sequence equals apiPackages entry for entry
there is no duplicate header and no header for a package outside apiPackages
tests.pseudocode: hdrs = [l[3:] for l in lines(golden) if l.startswith('== ')]; assert hdrs == apiPackages

tests.title: The four golden comparison tests pass against the ten-section golden with the update variable unset
given: AGENTKIT_UPDATE_API_GOLDEN is unset in the environment
the committed golden has ten sections
tests.when: go test ./internal/policy -run 'TS13_67|TS14_44|TS15_42|TS17_61' -v is run in a subprocess
then: the exit status is 0
the output shows PASS for each of the four tests
none of the four is reported SKIP
tests.pseudocode: out = run('go test ./internal/policy -run ... -v', env minus AGENTKIT_UPDATE_API_GOLDEN); assert exit==0; for id in ids: assert '--- PASS: ' contains id; assert 'SKIP' not in out

tests.title: A missing apiPackages directory fails the test with its path instead of skipping
given: a re-executed child test process (selected by an environment variable) that calls exportedAPI on a directory path that does not exist under the repository root
tests.when: the parent runs the child with go test and inspects its exit status and output
then: the child exits non-zero and reports FAIL, not SKIP
the output contains the missing directory's full path
tests.pseudocode: missing = root/'no-such-pkg'; out, err = runChild(env MISSING_DIR=missing); assert err != nil; assert 'FAIL' in out; assert 'SKIP' not in out; assert missing in out

tests.title: TS-17-61 keeps its separate preSpec17Guard list and still compares guard against it
given: preSpec17Guard in exported_api_17_test.go as spec 22 left it
tests.when: the test compares preSpec17Guard with the expected entries and with guard's exported lines
then: preSpec17Guard contains `func Allow(programs ...string) core.BeforeToolCall` first, followed by the pre-spec 22 entries unchanged
every entry of preSpec17Guard appears among exportedAPI(guard) lines
TS-17-61 itself passes
tests.pseudocode: assert preSpec17Guard[0]=='func Allow(programs ...string) core.BeforeToolCall'; lines=set(exportedAPI(t, root/'guard')); for e in preSpec17Guard: assert e in lines

tests.title: The prefix check fails and names the package and the missing prefix when the list is empty or lacks the line
given: the requireLine helper used by TS-24-2
a child test process that calls it with an empty list for `guard` and prefix `func Allow(`
tests.when: the parent runs the child and inspects its output
then: the child exits non-zero and reports FAIL
the message contains `guard` and `func Allow(`
tests.pseudocode: out, err = runChild(); assert err != nil; assert 'guard' in out and 'func Allow(' in out

tests.title: The five existing golden sections are unchanged and the new sections are only appended
given: the committed golden
git history is available with the spec 23 commit as an ancestor
tests.when: the test extracts the sections for `.`, `core`, `tools`, `codemode` and `workspace` from the golden and compares them with the lines exportedAPI prints for those directories; it also diffs the golden against the version before spec 24 with git
then: each of the five sections equals exportedAPI output for its directory, preceded by its `== <pkg>` header, in the first five positions
the git diff against the pre-spec-24 golden has no removed line (no line beginning with a single `-` other than the file header)
every added line lies after the workspace section
tests.pseudocode: for pkg in first5: assert section(golden, pkg) == exportedAPI(t, pkg); diff = git diff <pre-spec-24> -- golden; assert no line startswith '-' and not '---'

tests.title: exportedAPI output is sorted, deduplicated and stable over repeated calls
given: an unchanged working tree
tests.when: for any entry of apiPackages, exportedAPI is called twice
then: both calls return identical lists
each list is sorted ascending
no line appears twice
regenerating the golden twice in a row yields byte-identical files
tests.pseudocode: for pkg in apiPackages: a = exportedAPI(t, pkg); b = exportedAPI(t, pkg); assert a == b; assert a == sorted(a); assert len(set(a)) == len(a)

tests.title: TS-13-67 fails and lists the lines gained when a golden section differs from the code
given: the golden is copied to a backup and restored by t.Cleanup
one line of the `core` section is removed from the golden (not run in parallel with other policy tests)
tests.when: go test ./internal/policy -run TS13_67 is run in a subprocess with AGENTKIT_UPDATE_API_GOLDEN unset
then: the subprocess exits non-zero and reports FAIL
the output contains `exported API gained:` followed by the removed line
the golden file is restored byte-identically afterwards
tests.pseudocode: backup = read(golden); defer write(golden, backup); write(golden, drop_line(backup, core_section)); out, err = run(...); assert err != nil; assert 'exported API gained:' in out and dropped in out

tests.title: TS-19-64 finds no uncommitted change under internal/policy/testdata
given: the regenerated golden has been committed
tests.when: git status --porcelain -- internal/policy/testdata is run and TS-19-64 is run
then: the git status output is empty
TestGatewayLeavesTheBuild_TS19_64 passes
tests.pseudocode: assert run('git status --porcelain -- internal/policy/testdata') == ''; assert run('go test ./internal/policy -run TS19_64').exit == 0

tests.title: The Makefile's module loops cover every module in MODULES, mcpserve included
given: the Makefile with spec 23's MODULES
tests.when: make -n test, make -n vet and make -n lint are run and `make -pn` MODULES is read
then: the expanded MODULES value contains mcpserve
each dry-run loop text mentions every module in MODULES
check depends on fmt, vet, lint and test
tests.pseudocode: mods = parse(make -pn | grep '^MODULES'); assert 'mcpserve' in mods; for tgt in [test, vet, lint]: out = make -n tgt; for m in mods: assert m in out

tests.title: make doc exits 0 and leaves docs/generated unchanged from the committed tree
given: a committed tree
a git working directory
tests.when: make doc is run, then git status --porcelain -- docs/generated
then: make doc exits with status 0
the git status output is empty
docs/generated contains a file for mcpserve, guard and provider/faux
tests.pseudocode: assert run('make doc').exit==0; assert run('git status --porcelain -- docs/generated')==''; assert exists docs/generated/mcpserve/*.txt or mcpserve.txt

tests.title: make test reports the failing module and exits non-zero when a listed module fails
given: a temporary Go module in a temp directory whose only test calls t.Fatal
tests.when: make test MODULES=<tempdir> is run at the repository root
then: the exit status is non-zero
the output contains `go test ./... (<tempdir>)` naming the failing module
the loop continues to completion (exits with rc 1, not partway)
tests.pseudocode: out, code = run('make test MODULES='+tmp); assert code != 0; assert 'go test ./... ('+tmp+')' in out

tests.title: A maintainer regenerates the ten-section golden, commits it and every policy test passes
given: spec 20 to 23 code is in the tree
the golden is in a temporary copy of the committed state so the original can be restored
tests.when: AGENTKIT_UPDATE_API_GOLDEN=1 go test ./internal/policy -run TS13_67 is run, then go test ./internal/policy -count=1 is run with the variable unset
then: the regeneration run skips and writes a golden with ten `== <pkg>` sections in apiPackages order
the existing five sections are unchanged
a second regeneration produces byte-identical bytes
tests.pseudocode: run update; assert headers == apiPackages; cp golden g1; run update again; assert golden == g1; run all policy tests unset; assert exit 0
real_components: exportedAPI parsing the real source directories of all ten packages

tests.title: A maintainer runs make check in every module then make doc and finds no uncommitted generated docs
given: a committed tree containing spec 24's changes
go and make installed
tests.when: make check is run at the repository root, then make doc, then git status --porcelain -- docs/generated
then: make check runs fmt, vet, lint and test in each module in MODULES including mcpserve and exits 0
make doc exits 0
git status for docs/generated prints nothing
tests.pseudocode: assert run('make check').exit==0; assert run('make doc').exit==0; assert run('git status --porcelain -- docs/generated')==''
